en.headline: FEHD closes To Kwa Wan Market stall after vibrio cholera found in fish tank
en.dek: A water sample taken on 24 July from stall F22 on the first floor of the market at 165 Ma Tau Wai Road tested positive; the stall remains closed for thorough disinfection.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department ordered the temporary closure of a public market stall in Kowloon City on Thursday after detecting Vibrio cholera O1 in a water sample from its fish tank.

The sample was collected on 24 July from stall No. F22 on the first floor of To Kwa Wan Market at 165 Ma Tau Wai Road. The positive result was confirmed on 30 July. The Director of Food and Environmental Hygiene ordered the immediate temporary closure under the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance to protect public health.

The stall will remain closed for thorough cleaning and disinfection of the premises and fish tanks until the Director is satisfied that the hygiene condition poses no immediate health hazard. The FEHD reminded the public that Vibrio cholerae cannot survive high temperatures and can be killed by thorough cooking, and advised washing shellfish thoroughly, cooking seafood properly and avoiding cross-contamination between raw and cooked food.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣街市魚缸水驗出霍亂弧菌 食環署封閉檔位
zh.dek: 馬頭圍道165號土瓜灣街市一樓F22號檔位7月24日抽取的魚缸水樣本驗出O1群霍亂弧菌，檔位已即時暫時封閉徹底清潔消毒。
body: 食物環境衛生署星期四表示，九龍城一個公眾街市檔位的魚缸水樣本驗出O1群霍亂弧菌，已下令暫時封閉有關檔位以保障公眾健康。
樣本於7月24日在馬頭圍道165號土瓜灣街市一樓F22號檔位抽取，化驗結果於7月30日確診陽性。食環署署長根據《公眾衛生及市政條例》下令即時暫時封閉該檔位。
檔位須徹底清潔及消毒處所和魚缸，直至署長信納整體衞生情況不會對健康構成即時危害才可重開。食環署提醒公眾，霍亂弧菌不能在高溫下存活，徹底煮熟即可殺滅，並應徹底清洗貝類、妥善處理及煮熟海產，以及避免生熟食物交叉污染。
